questions.question: Why did rulers often target temples when they attacked rival kingdoms in medieval India?

options.text: To abolish the religious practices of the defeated kingdom.
To show their disrespect for all religions.
To acquire the vast wealth stored in temples and demonstrate their power over the defeated ruler.
